known_answer: We rotated the webhook signing secret on 8 September; Acme still verifies with the old secret and answers 401 invalid signature. Every other customer, receiving the same new payload format, gets 200.
decoy_answer: Our 8 September sender deploy changed the payload format and broke Acme's parser.
source: synthetic: the cause is fixed by construction in this task's files; no real system or client
